exposure: Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) diagnosed by current Danish criteria
Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) diagnosed by WHO2013 criteria
New-GDM (GDM diagnosed by WHO2013 but not by Danish criteria)
cohort: The participants were 465 pregnant women from Denmark who underwent a 75g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) at a median of 25.7 weeks' gestation.
finding: Untreated gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) identified by the WHO2013 criteria but missed by current Danish criteria was associated with significantly higher risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
gest_age: 24-28 weeks' gestation (for OGTT measurement); gestational age was also used to classify infants as large-for-gestational-age.
